description: This PHP script generates a report showing Test Cases that have not been executed on any platform within a specified test plan, by retrieving data from testlink database, processing results, and displaying the data in a table format.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A generic PHP class for dynamic object creation, used for GUI data organization.

classes.name: testPlanUrgency
classes.description: A class managing test plan urgency details, instantiated with database connection.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class managing test project data, instantiated with database connection.

classes.name: results
classes.description: A class for handling test results data, though instantiation is commented out in the code.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine wrapper used for rendering the report.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class for rendering external rich tables in the HTML report.

classes.name: tlHTMLTable
classes.description: A class for generating static HTML tables.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user possesses rights to view test plan metrics.

methods.name: buildMatrix
methods.description: Builds a table (either rich or static) to display test suite and test case data.

methods.name: buildMailCfg
methods.description: Constructs email configuration for report dissemination.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes arguments from session and request parameters.
